use_vasp_flags_for_slab_optimization: use the VASP_FLAGS dictionary to configure VASP parameters for slab and adsorbate slab geometry optimization
use_bulk_vasp_flags_for_crystal_optimiza: use the BULK_VASP_FLAGS dictionary to configure VASP parameters for bulk crystal structure optimization
use_solvent_base_flags_for_solvent_simul: use the SOLVENT_BASE_FLAGS dictionary to configure VASP parameters for solvent molecule simulations with dipole corrections
use_solvent_bulk_vasp_flags_for_solvent_: use the SOLVENT_BULK_VASP_FLAGS dictionary to configure VASP parameters for solvent bulk optimization with van der Waals corrections
use_relax_flags_for_quick_relaxation: use the RELAX_FLAGS dictionary to configure a minimal 5-step VASP relaxation run
